bio.heading: The short version
bio.bodyTodoNote: TODO: real bio from Esteban — keep cinematic, calm, confident. No corporate jargon, no superlatives without proof.
bio.paragraph1: Esteban is a South-Florida-based visual storyteller working across aerial, photography, videography, and post-production. He directs his own shoots and edits his own footage, which means clients get one creative point of view from the first frame to the final cut.
bio.paragraph2: Before going full-time behind the camera, Esteban spent years building a documentary-style eye for weddings, brand films, and lifestyle shoots — the kind of work where you have to read a room, move quietly, and still come away with the frame that makes the cut.
bio.paragraph3: He's licensed Part 107 for drone work, fluent in English and Spanish on set, and based out of South Florida with regular travel across the U.S. for brand and destination shoots.

brand.heading: How we think about the work
brand.body: We make things feel like a film. That means quiet directing on set, story-first editing in post, and color that doesn't shout. It also means picking the right tool — drone, camera, or edit suite — instead of leaning on the one we like best. Confident, cinematic, calm. No corporate jargon. No superlatives without proof.
